title: -59 (6-7) Anusayā1-
text: 3 Kathaṃ- -anusayā pahiyyantīti || la || || -anusayā samugghātam gacchantīti || || 4 Cakkhuṃ kho bhikkhave anattato jānato passato anusayā samugghātaṃ gacchanti || 5-8 Sotam || Ghānaṃ || Jivhaṃ || Kāyaṃ || 9 Manaṃ || || Dhamme || || Manoviññāṇaṃ || Manosamphassaṃ || || Yampidam manosamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkham asukhaṃ vā || tam pi anattato jānato passato anusayā samugghātaṃ gacchanti || || 10 Evaṃ kho bhikkhu jānato evam passato anusayā samugghāṭam gacchantīti || ||
